اقترئ (form VIII)
# اُقْتُرِئَ (uqturiʔa) /uq.tu.ri.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
# اِقْتَرِئْ (iqtariʔ) /iq.ta.riʔ/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
